*The '''Commander''' is the main [[Commander (Narrator)|narrator]] of the game.
*The {{Color|Premium|Galactic}} skin is based on the second version of the Level 5 Default upgrade.

*The {{Color|Halloween2019|Gargoyle}} skin was based on the [https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/615753550626291717/635786272480165888 Gargoyle Commander] skin submission made by {{RLinkU|KanoZ}}.
*The [[Commander]]'s skin tone in its upgrade icons and dialogue is different than the skin tone seen in-game.

*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Eggrypted}} skin icon is missing its watermelon stool.
*The {{Color|Other|Umbra}} skin is based on [[The Umbra]].

**It also uses the correct face.
*As part of a ''Pressure'' and Tower Defense Simulator collab, a skin for the '''Commander''' which would be based on [https://urbanshade.org/wiki/Sebastian_Solace Sebastian Solace]<ref>https://x.com/bluenavycmdrman/status/1978396470702174542<!--Ideally, the direct source of the video should be used if it exists, though since that is not known by anyone yet this is going to be enough. *A skin based on [[w:c:breakingbad:Jimmy McGill|Saul Goodman]] from the ''Breaking Bad'' franchise was made for the '''Commander''' and it would have released alongside the {{Color|Deluxe|Retired}} [[Cowboy]], though this never happened.
*The {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} skin bears a lot of resemblance to the [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/Captain Captain] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.

*The {{Color|Christmas2025|Candy Cane}} skin is a submission made by [https://x.com/OliverDalizard OliverDalizard].
